ingredients.item: beef brisket, frozen hard and machine-sliced paper-thin
ingredients.preparation: order "chadolbaegi" at a Korean market; freeze your own block 3–4 hours and have it sliced or shave it yourself on a mandoline

ingredients.item: Steamed rice , kimchi , sangchu geotjeori , soju's presence is traditional and optional

instructions.heading: Step 1
instructions.action: Lay the frozen shavings flat, one layer, as many as fit without touching. They cook in 8–12 seconds a side — the grill boss stands over them with tongs the entire time. The edge will crisp and frill while the center barely sets; that is the dish.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: the color change runs pink-frost to gray-brown at the edges with the fat turning translucent. Pull the slice the moment it no longer looks raw; a fully cooked-through chadolbaegi slice is a ruined one.

instructions.heading: Step 2
instructions.action: Dip while hot, straight from tongs to bowl to mouth. Rice between rounds; the fat is rich in a way that wants starch and acid beside it.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: eating test: crisp edge, melting center, the dip's vinegar and scallion cutting the fattiness. If it tastes purely of fat, the dip is too gentle — more vinegar and gochugaru.

instructions.heading: Step 3
instructions.action: Repeat in small batches. The shavings come off the freezer pack a handful at a time; any that thaw on the platter go on the grill immediately at a slightly cooler spot, or into the next round of fried rice instead.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: by the last batch the dip bowl should be reduced and cloudy from repeated dunking — the traditional end state, and the sign of a full table.

visualDonenessCues: the color change runs pink-frost to gray-brown at the edges with the fat turning translucent. Pull the slice the moment it no longer looks raw; a fully cooked-through chadolbaegi slice is a ruined one.
eating test: crisp edge, melting center, the dip's vinegar and scallion cutting the fattiness. If it tastes purely of fat, the dip is too gentle — more vinegar and gochugaru.
by the last batch the dip bowl should be reduced and cloudy from repeated dunking — the traditional end state, and the sign of a full table.
storageNotes: The frozen block keeps 2 months sealed; thawed slices should be cooked the same day. The dip keeps 3 days refrigerated and improves overnight.
Variations: the dip builds toward cho-gochujang (#SA03) for a hotter table; leftover shavings into kimchi fried rice; the same dip on grilled mushrooms (#SF02's lane) carries the vegan table.
